description: This file defines a Colors class implementing the ICollection interface, managing color entities within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, counting, and removing color records, and defines default color constants.

classes.name: Colors
classes.description: A class for managing color entities, including CRUD operations and default color definitions.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Retrieves a color by its ID.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a color by its color code.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a color record, ensuring required fields are present.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a filtered list of all non-deleted colors.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of notes associated with a color.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes colors by their IDs, unlinking relations and soft deleting.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a color exists by ID.
